member.name: M:Lumio.GameRuntime.Coordination.VoxelAdapters.VoxelFacadeNativeAbi.TryReadSectionBindings(Lumio.Engine.NativeLoader.KernelHandle,System.UInt64,System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{Lumio.GameRuntime.Ecs.SectionBindingEntry}@,System.UInt64@)
member.remarks: R-00768: LumioGameEngine landed the RootApi slot and NativeVoxelWorld.ReadSectionBindings wrapper after R-00727 was cut (R-00725, commit f6b576a), so this member is wired for real — the other four ADR-119 residency members (durability ack / unload / release / load) are wired below by R-00770. Probes with an empty buffer first (native honors a zero-capacity probe), then reads the exact once. section_unavailable (Pending or not-yet-loaded) is the documented miss and returns false, never an empty table; any other non-success status is an unexpected Native fault.

member.name: M:Lumio.GameRuntime.Coordination.VoxelAdapters.VoxelFacadeNativeAbi.DecodeBindingEntries(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte})
member.summary: Decodes voxel_section_binding_read_v1's canonical table bytes: u16 LE count, then entries strictly ascending by cell offset of u16 LE offset, u16 LE id length and UTF-8 id bytes (engine/wire/voxel-world-v1.json bindingRead; same shape as bindingSegment without its 0xFFFF marker). An empty table is just the two count bytes.

member.summary: Maps the ADR-119 residency refusal subset of (the generated contract enum from a caught .Code, never a hand-typed status int — ADR-121 R3) to the exact snake_case string engine/abi/native-abi.json's voxelErrors table declares for it — the same string Runtime's own IVoxelSectionResidencyPort double and DedicatedServerHostBinding already report for these codes.
